summary: The Ahmed family, consisting of Ali Ahmed (38), his wife Fatima, and their children Aisha (7) and Adam (5), was evaluated in their temporary accommodation in Huittinen, Finland. The visit aimed to assess their living conditions and family dynamics as part of the foster family assessment process. The family welcomed visitors warmly, maintaining a clean and well-maintained living space. The children were playful and well-behaved, while the parents expressed gratitude for the support they have received. Notable concerns included limited outdoor space and the children's lack of Finnish fluency, impacting their school integration. The family's resilience and proactive engagement with support services have led to a low case severity classification. Recommendations include language support, exploring permanent accommodation options, and arranging meetings with local schools to address educational needs.
